distinction: Observations are from supplied lesson assets. Next tests are proposals.

findings.observation: At N = 8, the illustrative fog rubric selects Take 07 on intensity alone. The balanced rubric selects Take 04.
findings.next_test: Compare both rules with independent choices on unseen drives.

findings.lesson: Wet pavement can still miss night.
findings.observation: The night-rain clip received 5/5 for blind overall quality. With the target and source, the model rated condition match 2/5.
findings.next_test: Label wetness and time of day separately, then count failures the judge accepts.

findings.lesson: A perfect score can overlook an addition.
findings.observation: The paired review named the striped hood yet rated structure 5/5. All 735 paired structure ratings in this batch were 5/5.
findings.next_test: Test additions and removals against independent labels. Measure both false acceptance and false rejection.
